claimBoundary: Pre-registered accelerator comparison only. No 13 TOPS or 26 TOPS AI HAT has been received, run, measured, purchased, borrowed, qualified, selected, rejected, or shown compatible with VCG; no replay corpus, live participant session, camera exposure timestamp, Hailo HEF, post-processor, complete runtime tuple, power, thermal, accuracy, action, game, or cost result exists.
sourceDigestContract: SHA-256 over strict UTF-8 after CRLF-to-LF normalization; bare carriage returns are rejected

comparisonLanes.purpose: paired model, pose, action, throughput, drop, CPU and memory comparison
comparisonLanes.inputRule: both variants consume the exact same ordered decoded frame bytes and labels from one hash-bound corpus
comparisonLanes.timingBoundary: source-frame admission to pose and action output; never reported as camera-exposure latency

comparisonLanes.purpose: camera exposure to action, live drops, controls, thermals, power and stability
comparisonLanes.inputRule: same exact camera, room, script and participant protocol with accelerator order counterbalanced; sessions are not called identical inputs
comparisonLanes.timingBoundary: camera exposure midpoint to recognized-action receipt at the game API on a shared or measured clock

comparisonLanes.purpose: complete-host capacity, frame pacing, resources, power, thermal and throttling comparison
comparisonLanes.inputRule: each variant runs the same versioned VCG workload trace with identical game settings and accelerator order counterbalanced
comparisonLanes.timingBoundary: monotonic target-host observation only, with camera exposure timing reported separately

requiredMetrics: per-landmark missing rate, p50, p95 and worst torso-normalized error
dodge-left, dodge-right, duck and jump precision, recall, F1 and false-event rate
floor-contact and lift event precision, recall and timing when independent truth is authorized
source-admission-to-pose and source-admission-to-action p50, p95, p99 and worst
live exposure-to-pose and exposure-to-action p50, p95, p99 and worst with uncertainty
capture, admission, inference, post-process, tracking, action and delivery drops
pose FPS plus game FPS and frame-time p50, p95, p99 and worst
CPU, GPU, RAM, swap and accelerator utilization
wall power, SoC and accelerator temperature, clock and throttle state
cold start, steady-state and recovery behavior
same-date delivered price and complete-system BOM delta
